content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-162. - Conflicts.
content.summary:
Where the minimum distances provided in this article differ from those prescribed
               in the schedule of districts in the zoning ordinance of the city, the distances prescribed
               by the zoning ordinance shall take precedence.
